messages:
alex_k: FYI — incident in eu-west caused throttling on the model store. requesting a pause on tonight's feature rollout (21:00 UTC).
maria_s: ack, can you pin the release and stop the pipeline? we don't want partial canaries.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy 2024-06-15T21:00Z for service 'inference-api' has been PAUSED by alex_k. Canary jobs stopped. Reason: incident-eu-2024-06-15.
oncall-bot: Incident #INC-2024-114 assigned to samir and kai. ETA for mitigation ~40m.
samir: looking into transient S3 throttles hitting model fetches. rolling back a recent nodepool autoscaler tweak to test.
kai: noted — if fetch failures persist we'll do a graceful rollback for the model-serving release. prefer to keep route stable.
alex_k: maria can you pin the release artifacts to avoid accidental re-deploys? e.g. run:
```
cli tools/redwood release pin --service inference-api --version 2024.6.15-rc3
```
That will force the pipeline to use the current artifact until we re-open the window.
maria_s: pinned and added a note in the release notes: "PAUSED due to INC-2024-114. Awaiting infra confirmation." tag: ops-pause
maria_s: also updated the deploybot override: `deploy-bot override --lock 1718502345 --reason "incident pause"`
deploy-bot: Override lock applied by maria_s. Canary queue drained. Notifying oncall.
alex_k: decision: no automatic rollback yet. If S3 error rate doesn't fall within next 30m -> rollback model-serving to last stable (2024.6.01).
kai: +1, and let's shift the change window to TOMORROW 02:00 UTC to reduce risk and give ops time. that works for infra?
samir: infra agrees to 02:00 UTC tomorrow. we'll keep canary disabled and run a manual canary once we confirm model fetch rates back to baseline.
maria_s: I'll file the reschedule and update the calendar invite. also note for CS: hold release notes publication until we greenlight.
alex_k: add a post-deploy smoke test checklist to the runbook. sample command to validate KV cache and kernels:
```
curl -sS https://smoke.internal/inference-api/health | jq .
python infra/tests/smoke_check.py --model gpt-4o-mini --seq 1024
```
samir: re: rollback — I've prepped the rollback playbook and pinned the rollback tag to the pipeline: `rollback:2024.6.01` ready.
kai: thanks. I'll monitor the incident channel and re-open the deploy when infra confirms stable.
alex_k: ok closing here for now — deploy window paused, artifacts pinned, rollback ready, new window 2024-06-16T02:00Z. ping in this thread when ready to proceed. :thumbsup:
